doc.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Hearing a Concord recording with Marshall Royal
summary: Monk plays a live Concord record, and Lanny recalls its players.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well I wanted to play a couple of things that you’ve played on if you don’t mind —
Is this going to be painful for me?
No, I don’t think it is. I think they’re pretty darn good myself.
This has got to be live at the Concord.
Well that’s Marshall playing lead you know.

That was a good record. It really was a good record. I think one of the best parts about that record was Richie Kamuca, who I’ve always been a big fan of Richie’s. And of course Marshall too, and I think Blue was on that too, wasn’t he? Didn’t Blue do, wasn’t Blue Mitchell on that?
Actually this recording is from, I think it’s a live—
But it was done live at Concord. But it was a good band.
